fichas.title: Restaurant Kitchens: Planning and Organisation
fichas.summary: Small and medium-sized restaurant kitchens require planning that responds to customer capacity, the type and quality of meals, the share of food prepared from raw ingredients, and customer turnover. Functional diagrams show goods, waste, container and crockery flows, and the relationships between kitchen and service areas.
uses: Manage goods, waste, container and crockery circulation

fichas.title: Restaurant Kitchen Areas: Space Required per Seat
fichas.summary: A table gives functional area requirements in square metres per seat for kitchens serving 80, 120 and 200 seats. Values are listed by area, including delivery, storage, preparation, production, washing and service. Some entries are printed as “fridge” rather than as numeric values.
uses: Plan kitchen floor area by function and seating capacity

fichas.title: Basis for Kitchen Dimensions and Space Requirements
fichas.summary: The page gives percentage allocations for kitchen functions, totalling 100%, and illustrates the classification and relationships of functional areas in clean and unclean zones. Earth-covered vegetables, if prepared, are to be handled in a separate part of the unclean area.
uses: Allocate total kitchen space among functions
